contracts_rationale: Test-only mission: no API, event or schema interface is added or changed.
purpose_context: The 2026-11-03 test suite assessment (W3, R2) and #320 found eight wall-clock deadline checks in five packs test files that a starved CI runner could trip, the failure mode of #316. Per ADR-0057 and the operator's landing pass they stay in :packs:test and are not tagged timing; each is widened into a hang cap far above the work's own time, or made to assert the cause instead of the clock.
purpose_tldr: Stop eight tight wall-clock checks in the packs tests from flaking on a loaded runner, while they keep gating the guards they prove.
